audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls this HARD at 8/10 difficulty while the packet win rate is 53.51% over 185 games, the packet levelChart is Neeko on all seven rows, the content layer win[0..6] is Neeko on all seven rows, and every phases[N].why describes Neeko winning that stage. Only phases[N].side said Irelia.
audit.why: Difficulty must agree with the chart and the win rate the site renders. Seven rows of side=Irelia sitting above seven whys that describe Neeko dominating is the exact two-answers-to-one-question defect.
audit.corrected: diff FAVOURED, diffRating 4/10, all seven phases[N].side moved to Neeko with each why rewritten to Irelia-specific grounds in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text asserted 'she has no sustain in her kit' (spikes[2].text), 'she has no sustain' (whys[5]) and 'her kit carries no sustain or hard escape' (content late).
audit.why: Bladesurge (Q) heals Irelia on every strike and refreshes on a Marked or dying target, so she sustains through chip damage all lane. This is the flagged missing interaction (needs-antiheal) for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Replaced the no-sustain claims with the real spike logic: Grievous Wounds must be down before the extended trade, and the burst window is before her passive stacks.
sources: enemyKit Q Bladesurge text + heal flag

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no real numbers ('matchup-defining — Her stun setup'), and Defiant Dance (W) was never mentioned anywhere despite being the single ability that changes how you damage her.
audit.why: Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage during the charge; Neeko's Q, E and R are magic, so charging W does not blunt your combo — it only telegraphs her commit. Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s and it Marks you, which is what refreshes Bladesurge. Vanguard's Edge is 125/105/85s.
audit.corrected: Real per-rank cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns and the loading tips; Defiant Dance's physical-only reduction stated in tradeGood.
sources: enemyKit W/E/R cooldowns and Riot text

audit.why: 53.51% over 185 games, used as the sole figure; no elo tiers written anywhere.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pronouns: the whole full layer addressed Irelia as he/his/him (tldr, ahead, breakdown.early, dosFull[1].t, dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[0].t, report[8].t).
audit.why: champ-gender lists irelia as female. The owner is addressed as 'you', so every third-person pronoun in these fields refers to Irelia.
audit.corrected: All misgendered fields rewritten with she/her.

audit.whatIsWrong: No punishable cooldown was ever named with a duration.
audit.why: Flawless Duet at rank 1 is down 16s and it is her only stun and her only Mark source; the window after it whiffs is the entire green light in this lane.
audit.corrected: Stated in winCon, loading and breakdown.cooldowns with the per-rank list.

notes: Chart flipped to Neeko on all seven rows: side was Irelia while every why, the packet levelChart, the content win[0..6] and the 53.51% win rate all said Neeko. content win[N] was already 'Neeko' so no paired content edit was needed — the pair agrees after this proposal. phases[N].rating left untouched (8/10, 8/10, 8/10, 8/10, 7/10, 7/10, 7/10) because the rating's polarity is ambiguous and the chart rule says leave what you cannot ground; likewise tone '#ff5d6c' still reads as a hard-matchup red after diff moved to FAVOURED — someone should reconcile tone with the diff palette. Irelia E derived flag says 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes'; Riot's own description of Flawless Duet says only damage, stun and Mark, so I did not assert grounding anywhere (flag likely misfires). Same for the R 'terrain blocks dashes' flag — the description says the wall damages and slows walkers, so I did not claim it stops your Pop Blossom leap. Removed three separate 'Irelia has no sustain' claims, which are contradicted by Bladesurge's heal. Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js). MISGENDER: the enemy is female and the full layer addressed her as male; every flagged field corrected in place.
